item.title: Kobe Beef: The World's Most Famous Wagyu — Guide
item.description: Kobe beef is the most famous wagyu on earth, and unusually for a global brand it is tightly defined: only carcasses from purebred Tajima cattle, born, raised and slaughtered in Hyogo Prefecture and meeting strict marbling and weight grades, may carry the name — a few thousand animals a year. The Tajima breed from northern Hyogo is the source of that quality, its meat threaded with exceptionally fine marbling that melts at low temperature.
